name: DEV - 04B Creator Candidate Selection and Image Routing

parameters.content:
# Creator image routing
Keep unpublished until the user requests testing. Four selected candidates become the designer root; other candidates move to a separate rejected piece archive. References follow the original piece, which moves last. Root final copies are preserved under _run/final_copies. A conditional data-table mutex serializes writes and durable journals resume the SAME selection. Hard interruption leaves the lock held: terminate/check the original execution before resetting it. ZIP cleanup is a separate post-generator/reviewer workflow.
